title: psammisia costeroides
intro: Psammisia costeroides, commonly known as the "Puna Capuchin", is a species of flowering plant in the family Ericaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to help with inflammation, pain relief, and as an antiseptic. The therapeutic actions of Psammisia costeroides are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids and phenolic acids that exhibit antioxidant, antimicrobial, and anti-inflammatory properties.
